title: model-family kernel picker + GQA/MQA tuning + Qwen KV-cache stride fix
author: Ava Chen
description: Context: we observed higher tail latency and sporadic OOMs when serving mixed workloads containing Mistral, Qwen and Llama family models. Root causes were: (1) suboptimal kernel selection for fused rotary/attention on Mistral and some Llama variants, (2) misaligned group-quantization (GQA) code paths that spilled to host under certain MQA layouts, and (3) a KV-cache pointer/stride bug in Qwen cache layout that created fragmentation under continuous batching. This PR introduces a model-family aware kernel picker (heuristics based on model_family, hidden_size, seq_dist) that prefers fused-rotary + threaded attention kernels for Mistral/Llama; adds quantization-aware attention execution paths to handle GQA/MQA edge cases (avoids fp16->host spills by switching to a compact packed layout when group sizes mismatch); fixes Qwen KV-cache stride/pointer arithmetic and compacts cache layout to reduce working set; and adjusts continuous-batcher thresholds and micro-batch sizing per-model to prevent cross-model OOMs. Also includes unit/integration tests, perf microbench harness updates, and a staged rollout plan (canary -> 30% -> global). Motivation and impact: these are production-facing fixes that improve latency and stability without requiring model rewrites. Backwards-compatible toggles are exposed as runtime knobs (kernel_picker.mode, quant.tune_mode, kvcache.compact_layout) that default to safe behavior. Rollout notes: start with canary in us-west-2 for 48 hours, monitor token-level latency and OOM counts, then 30% for 72 hours before global.

review_comments: Diego Martinez: Can you add stable perf numbers with a replayed mixed workload? The initial numbers look promising but we need determinism.
Ava Chen: Added deterministic workload harness and results in perf_benchmarks, also wired CI perf check to run with fixed seeds.
Priya Kapoor: The quant fallback looks safe but please call out any additional mem overhead. Also prefer a feature flag for 30-day grace.

Ava Chen: quant.tune_mode default uses compact-packed only when group sizes misalign; documented expected ~0.6-1.4% peak memory overhead in worst-case and added a runtime flag quant.tune_mode=off for emergency rollback.
Ethan Li: Verified that fused_rotary path is a pure opt for Mistral-7B and doesn't regress Llama-7B; approved after smoke tests on dedicated pools.
release_notes: Improved model-family kernel selection for Mistral/Llama, fixed Qwen KV-cache stride fragmentation, and added GQA/MQA-safe quantization fallback. Result: lower p50/p95 latency and fewer OOMs under mixed workloads. Exposed runtime knobs for gradual rollout and rollback.
testing_summary: Repro: mixed-workload harness (Mistral-7B, Llama-13B, Qwen-14B) ran for 100k requests with deterministic seeds. Added CI perf job that runs 3x stable-seed trials. Canary in us-west-2 for 48h with observed telemetry; then 30% for 72h. No regressions in unit/integration suites.
perf_benchmarks: Mistral-7B small-chat workload: p50 token latency -11%, p95 -22%, throughput +18% (adaptive batching)
Llama-13B mixed prompt workload: p50 token latency -8%, p95 -19%, throughput +12%
Qwen-14B long-context streaming: p50 token latency -10% after KV-cache compaction, memory working set reduced ~14%
Small model fleet (7B family) aggregate mixed load: average tokens/sec +20% and OOMs reduced from 6->0 in stress runs
